title: Microsoft Entra ID: passkey support for B2B guest users
summary: The briefing accurately distinguishes the planned, automatically enabled guest capability from Learn's current statements that guest passkeys are unsupported. The documented controls and licensing check out; minor corrections are needed to complete targeting instructions, explain API properties in the table notes, and align the checklist with its control rows.
